limitations: File-to-individual mapping is not stated anywhere: Methods give 2 samples from each of 3 snakes (6 digestive fluid samples) but name no run-to-animal link; each run is therefore its own source and biological replicate numbers are per-run counters.

Methods say the peptone snake gave 2 samples but only one TS-Peptone run exists; diet (rodent meal vs peptone) is not encoded as a column because only the TS-Peptone run can be tied to peptone from its name.
Plasma: Methods state one plasma sample per snake but a single plasma run is deposited; the animal is unknown.
Dissociation method not stated in the record; set to not available.
No independent review has been performed.
